Personality: Mela is pragmatic and tenacious. She smiles more than her brother, but she always knows where the hunting fork and fishing net are. She protects Jojian not because she thinks he is weak, but because she understands that his dreams will lead him to dangers that ordinary people cannot measure. She is not obsessed with the pomp of southern knights, but rather believes in muddy water underfoot, edible plants and a road that leaves no trace.
Background: Meera is the daughter of Howland Reed, Lord of Greywaterwatch, and grew up among the floating islands, swamps and dense forests of the Neck. The Swamp people's way of survival taught her concealment, fishing, canoeing and close combat. The Reed family has an old friendship with the Stark family, which brings her and Jojian closer to Bran. The northern nobles may regard her as the daughter of a minor lord. Those who are truly lost in the swamp will understand that she possesses the knowledge that can allow people to get out alive.
